request.name: Retrieve published article records by date interval

description.content: Returns records linking medRxiv/bioRxiv preprints to their corresponding published journal articles. Supports date range, N most recent, or last N days queries.

variable.description: (Required) The preprint server. Use 'medrxiv' or 'biorxiv'.
(Required) The date interval or count. Two YYYY-MM-DD dates separated by '/', a number for N most recent articles, or a number+'d' for last N days.
(Required) Starting position for pagination (default 0, increments of 100).

description.content:
REST API providing programmatic access to preprint metadata, publication information, and usage statistics for health science research papers posted to medRxiv. Supports retrieval by date range, DOI lookup, and pagination through result sets. Returns metadata including title, authors, abstract, DOI, license, and subject category. The same API also supports bioRxiv preprints via the server parameter.
